$comment: Zap template intents for the juwri Zapier app. The `juwri` side of every template references a real operation key in this package (validated by test/templates.test.js). The other app's key is descriptive — set the exact partner step when authoring the templates in the Zapier Partner dashboard after publish.

templates.title: Post new juwri orders to Slack
templates.description: When a new order is placed in juwri, post a message to a Slack channel.

templates.title: Log new juwri orders to a Google Sheet
templates.description: When a new order is placed in juwri, add a row to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

templates.title: Record paid juwri orders in QuickBooks
templates.description: When an order is marked paid in juwri, create a sales receipt in QuickBooks Online.

templates.title: Text customers when their order status changes
templates.description: When an order changes status in juwri, send an SMS with Twilio.

templates.title: Add new juwri customers to Mailchimp
templates.description: When a new customer is created in juwri, add or update a Mailchimp subscriber.

templates.title: Save new juwri customers to Google Contacts
templates.description: When a new customer is created in juwri, create a Google Contact.

templates.title: Put new juwri reservations on Google Calendar
templates.description: When a new reservation is created in juwri, create a detailed Google Calendar event.

templates.title: Alert finance in Slack on juwri refunds
templates.description: When a refund is completed in juwri, post a message to a Slack channel.

templates.title: Create juwri menu items from a Google Sheet
templates.description: When a new row is added to a Google Sheet, create a menu item in juwri.

templates.title: Turn Typeform responses into juwri customers
templates.description: When a Typeform entry is submitted, create a customer in juwri.
